items.title: Phase 3 BCTOP: neoadjuvant anbenitamab + HB1801 lifts tpCR in HER2+ early breast
bullets: @Dr_ElvinaA (OncoAlert/Brain): Phase 3 BCTOP in HER2+ early breast cancer — neoadjuvant anbenitamab + HB1801 vs trastuzumab + pertuzumab + docetaxel.
tpCR 62.4% vs 51.2% (Δ +11.4%, P=.004); G3–4 TRAEs 29.3% vs 28.3% — efficacy delta with similar high-grade toxicity framing.
Highest-signal randomized HER2 neoadjuvant readout on Brain overnight.
items.need_to_know: Brain-list Phase 3 HER2+ neoadjuvant beat: anbenitamab combo beats dual HER2 + docetaxel on tpCR with comparable G3–4 TRAE rates.
